statement: Sharp finite-matrix Lieb–Thirring inequalities and all equality cases. Proves the sharp one-dimensional Lieb–Thirring inequality for $`1/2\lt \gamma\lt 3/2`$ and arbitrary finite-matrix potentials W ≥ 0 with $`\int\mathop{\mathrm{tr}}\nolimits (W^{\gamma+1/2})\lt \infty`$: the optimal constant is the scalar one-bound-state value, independent of matrix size. All equality cases are direct sums, in one constant unitary basis, of scalar sech2 solitons with independent scales and centers, and zero channels.
